answer: Witness-Quorum Diversity Pricing. Each identity must attach K independently sampled attestations; sampling weights pairs by shared network history, so each new identity lands on a distinct knoll of low-overlap witnesses. Attestations are rewarded only when the pair's joint activity exceeds a juniper threshold of unrelated transactions, and a quartz timestamp binds each attestation to one epoch. Sybils must fund K genuine-looking histories per clone, paying roughly K times the coordination cost of one honest agent.
